entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales' or 'Support' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I... I need to do a return. The website was very confusing and I'm not sure what to do. I have my order number if that helps?
Of course, I can certainly help you with that. Can you please provide me with the order number?
Okay, hold on... it's VF88602. It's for that ClubFit jersey.

Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the ClubFit Jersey, delivered on December 30th. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
Oh, um, I guess preference? I think I ordered the wrong size. I tried it on and it’s just way too tight across the chest. I'm so overwhelmed with all the options. Can't you just help me exchange it?
I understand completely. So just to confirm, you'd like to process an exchange for the jersey because the sizing wasn't right for you. Is that correct?
Yes, exactly! It’s the wrong size. I just want one that fits.

Not a problem at all. Let me just check the policy for you... Okay, I see here that your item was delivered 16 days ago. Our standard items, like this jersey, have a 90-day return window. So, you're well within that timeframe. I can definitely go ahead and start that return for you.
Oh, thank goodness. That's a huge relief. The policies all seem so complicated. So... what do I do next?

It's my pleasure to clarify it for you. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label as we speak. You can just print that out, place it on the original packaging, and drop it off at the post office. Once we receive it, would you prefer a full refund, or would you like me to process that exchange for the next size up?
The exchange, please! The next size up would be perfect. Thank you so much, Isaac, you've made this so much easier.
You're very welcome. I have set up the exchange in our system. Once our warehouse scans your return, the new jersey will be sent out automatically. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
Happy to help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
